rounding_policy: No rounding: cumulative fields store the exact arithmetic sum of the per-entry estimated_cost_usd values (0.0001 + 0.05 + 0.07 + 0.03 + 0.05 + 0.03 = 0.2301).
note: Costs are estimates based on published per-token pricing (xai grok-4 ~$5/$15 per 1M in/out; mistral-large ~$2/$6 per 1M in/out). Actual provider invoices not available in-session. All estimates are conservative upper bounds. Cumulative is the exact sum of entries (no rounding). Well under $100 cap.
